callees.name: validate_plugin
callees.pre_condition: plugin_dir is a pathlib.Path pointing to an existing directory whose name does not start with '.' and is not '__pycache__'.
callees.post_condition: Returns None if plugin_dir does not contain a valid plugin.json whose parsed configuration satisfies all PluginConfig validation rules (non-empty name, valid version, valid stage type and configuration for each declared stage). Otherwise returns a PluginConfig whose name attribute is non-empty and serves as the plugin's registration key.
